title: A/P Detail: changing the date closes open buckets
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • The "Current" bucket has at least one bill.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Open "Current".
  4. Set the date chip to yesterday.
  5. Read the bucket rows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • every bucket is closed.

Why this matters: A new date is a new report.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-payable/ApAgingDetailReport.vue:473-479. V1 code, quoted: `watch(() => asOfDate.value, () => { expandedKeys.value = new Set(); Object.assign(visibleCounts, initialVisibleCounts()); });`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-140) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.
